name: Puttadi - Cumbummettu Road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR, Puttadi - Cumbummettu Road, crosses the border between Tamil Nadu and Kerala. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — TN Highways and Kerala PWD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
